summary: Turn conversations into code with @GitHub in Slack and Teams! Investigate bugs, create issues, implement changes, and open pull requests—all without leaving your conversation.
takeaways: Additional improvements Faster onboarding: Go from request to coding session with fewer steps. @GitHub now identifies the repository from your message and launches your session without requiring you to select it again.
Clearer attribution: Issues and pull requests created by @GitHub now include “Created from a Slack/Teams conversation with @username” in their description.
Get started Try @GitHub in Slack or Teams .
